THE COURT-ACCESS PROJECT IS A NOT-FOR-PROFIT ORGANIZATION, CREATED FOR THE SOLE PURPOSE OF ELIMINATING THE GLOBAL PROBLEM OF ILLEGAL PRETRIAL DETENTION BETWEEN ARREST AND FIRST COURT APPEARANCE BY USING TECHNOLOGY AND, SPECIFICALLY, THE COURT-ACCESS APP. THE COURT-ACCESS APP IS A SIMPLE AND INEXPENSIVE DIGITAL SYSTEM TO NOTIFY COURTS OF ALL ARRESTS. USING A SMART-PHONE TYPE DEVICE, THE POLICE WILL ENTER BASIC RELEVANT INFORMATION ABOUT A SUSPECT ON THE COURT-ACCESS APP AT THE TIME OF ARREST. APPLYING LOCAL LAWS, THE APP WILL AUTOMATICALLY CALCULATE THE DAY THE SUSPECT MUST APPEAR BEFORE AN INDEPENDENT MAGISTRATE AND NOTIFY THE CLERK OF THE COURT. THE COURT CLERK WILL THEN PLACE THE SUSPECT ON THE COURT'S CALENDAR ON THE STATUTORILY SET DAY. IF THE SUSPECT DOES NOT APPEAR IN COURT THAT DAY, THE MAGISTRATE WILL KNOW AND ORDER THE DETAINING AUTHORITIES TO PRODUCE HIM IN COURT. BY ENSURING TIMELY EARLY JUDICIAL INTERVENTION, THE COURT-ACCESS APP WILL ELIMINATE ILLEGAL DETENTION BETWEE

Through innovative scientific research and the development of safe geoengineering methods, AIP addresses the rapid loss of Arctic sea ice, a critical factor in global climate regulation. Preserving the Arctics reflective ice cover helps mitigate global warming and safeguard ecosystems. AIP is developing environmentally safe Surface Albedo Modification (SAM) techniques using materials like hollow glass microspheres (HGMs) to enhance the reflectivity of sea ice. This increased reflectivity can disrupt the feedback loops that accelerate ice melt, contributing to the stabilization of Arctic temperatures and the global climate. Grounded in scientific rigor, safety, and a commitment to restoring the Arctic ecosystem, AIP collaborates with diverse stakeholders to deliver innovative and responsible solutions to one of the planets most urgent climate challenges.

IN THE THIRD PHASE OF TREATMENT, CLIENTS RECEIVE OUTPATIENT SERVICES INCLUDING INDIVIDUAL AND GROUP THERAPY SESSIONS, AS WELL AS MENTORING SERVICES PROVIDED BY ADULT PEER SUPPORT SPECIALISTS (APSS).
